test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'DAM’ is coded as '50' and 'PAD' is coded as '47'. How will 'MAP' be coded in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Logic: Consonants opposite value + Vowels place value **+ 12 = Code.**

Now,

'DAM’ is coded as '50'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a093a4e98be31de844542ba702705f1b10a1c5bc57e4bf7fc97ef35dccb0c0b0.png] 

For, 'PAD' is coded as '47'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/864f66d55d31965daf694da72acedff9cb03ca4f25f2a75d248df7b424e37bd3.png] 

Similarly, for ‘**MAP**’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fab37f046ccf2f6bfad14ee8799976526e1ce6afd3faf9bc3ad6485833150ddb.png] 

So, **'MAP' will be coded as '38'**.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
